children: NXP Semiconductors reported higher third-quarter profit as revenue in its automotive and industrial segments picked up.
The company posted net income of $899 million, up from $646 million the year prior. On a per-share basis, earnings attributable to stockholders rose to $3.48 a share, up from $2.48 a share.
Adjusted earnings were $4.20 a share. Analysts polled by FactSet expected $4.12 a share.
Revenue rose 19% to $3.79 billion, boosted by 13% growth in automotive revenue and 39% growth in industrial revenue. Wall Street expected $3.76 billion.

The company guided for fourth-quarter revenue of $3.75 billion to $3.95 billion and earnings of $3.36 to $3.79 a share. Analysts see fourth-quarter revenue of $3.86 billion and earnings of $3.77 a share.

"Our performance was driven by accelerating contributions from our company-specific growth drivers in automotive and industrial as well as continued momentum in data center infrastructure," said Chief Executive Rafael Sotomayor.
